verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents its own 3D Secure solution. It supports configurable challenge rules and webhook notifications so the developer can deliver the challenge through their own channel, which covers part of the online-credential side of the story. Nothing in the pack covers PIN management, and no evidence shows 3DS enrollment is done via API without support involvement. Missing for 10: PIN set/reset API flows, explicit API-driven 3DS enrollment per card or region, self-serve (no support ticket) confirmation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, cardholder credentials are manageable through the API — PIN set and reset flows, 3DS enrollment for online use where the region requires it — without support tickets
